notes.title: Hentai Beauties Demo is out!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Exciting news – the new demo of Hentai Beauties is out now, showcasing three stunning girls and fixed bugs. 

We've poured six months of hard work and love into this project. We'd really appreciate your help spreading the word by telling your friends, sharing in your groups and discords, and spreading the love for our game! 

[b]Thanks for your ongoing support. Let's enjoy this together![/b]

[h3]Try the demo on our [url=https://sapphirebeaver.itch.io/hentai-beauties]itch.io page[/url] or our [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/902691]newgrounds page[/url]!
[/h3]
